title: Human stem cell neuroscience
abstract: In neuroscience, the most relevant human biology has often been the least accessible. Stem-cell-based models, such as organoids and assembloids, are opening ways to generate, assemble, probe, and perturb neural cells and circuits, helping define "stem cell neuroscience." In this issue of Neuron, this and other reviews and commentaries discuss the current state of this emerging field.
abstract_zh: 在神经科学中，最相关的人类生物学往往也是最难以获取的。以干细胞为基础的模型，如类器官和类组织体，为生成、组装、探测和干扰神经元及神经回路开辟了新途径，有助于界定“干细胞神经科学”。本期《Neuron》杂志中的本及其他综述和评论文章，讨论了这一新兴领域的现状。
